propositions: AC checklist items with operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, merge-gate, store-surgery, etc.) must be tagged [operator-attested] or the lint flags them as advisory guidance
A deterministic lexicon-based advisory lint (P6 family, non-blocking) detects untagged operational-evidence AC items using frozen corpus evaluation with precision ≥70% and flag rate ≤5%

The operator-attested tag matcher is single-sourced in det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE and re-exported/imported by workflow_ops to ensure plan-time lint and completion-verifier agree on tagged items
The lint extends p6_ac_quality without adding new DET checks or routing entries; DET_CHECKS remains exactly 9 and CANONICAL_DET unchanged
Historical cases (115b and 8c4f) that burned close-gate cycles due to untagged operational evidence are covered by unit-test fixtures that confirm the lint fires on their AC text
